paper_metadata.title: Phi-4-reasoning Technical Report
paper_metadata.abstract: We introduce Phi-4-reasoning, a 14-billion parameter reasoning model that achieves strong performance on complex reasoning tasks. Trained via supervised fine-tuning of Phi-4 on carefully curated set of "teachable" prompts-selected for the right level of complexity and diversity-and reasoning demonstrations generated using o3-mini, Phi-4-reasoning generates detailed reasoning chains that effectively leverage inference-time compute. We further develop Phi-4-reasoning-plus, a variant enhanced through a short phase of outcome-based reinforcement learning that offers higher performance by generating longer reasoning traces. Across a wide range of reasoning tasks, both models outperform significantly larger open-weight models such as DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B model and approach the performance levels of full DeepSeek-R1 model. Our comprehensive evaluations span benchmarks in math and scientific reasoning, coding, algorithmic problem solving, planning, and spatial understanding. Interestingly, we observe a non-trivial transfer of improvements to general-purpose benchmarks as well. In this report, we provide insights into our training data, our training methodologies, and our evaluations. We show that the benefit of careful data curation for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) extends to reasoning language models, and can be further amplified by reinforcement learning (RL). Finally, our evaluation points to opportunities for improving how we assess the performance and robustness of reasoning models.

extraction_data.innovation: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on carefully curated 'teachable' prompts and reasoning demonstrations generated using o3-mini; enables detailed reasoning chains leveraging inference-time compute.
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on reasoning tasks, Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on synthetic CoT data; Reinforcement Learning (RL) for the 'plus' variant.
extraction_data.extension: Repurposes two placeholder tokens as explicit  reasoning tokens, and extends maximum context length to 32K by doubling the RoPE base frequency.
extraction_data.research_problem: Unlocking structured reasoning behavior and extended chain-of-thought traces in compact models.
extraction_data.application: Mathematical problem solving, logical reasoning, scientific reasoning, coding, algorithmic problem solving, planning, spatial understanding
extraction_data.finetuning_data: 1.4M prompts with high-quality answers generated using o3-mini; STEM, coding, safety-focused tasks, Publicly available websites, existing datasets, licensed collections, synthetically generated problems, rewritten/transformed seeds.
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on curated prompts and reasoning demonstrations
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: Reasoning demonstrations generated using o3-mini, Synthetic generation using o3-mini; rewriting and transforming filtered seeds into new synthetic datasets (e.g., coding to word problems, math with short solutions).
extraction_data.rl_algorithm: Reinforcement Learning (RL), GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization)
extraction_data.reward_mechanism: Verifiable solutions (outcome-based rewards), Accuracy-based reward (R_final) designed to reward longer responses for incorrect answers; max possible R ≈ 0.62
extraction_data.safety_evaluation_protocol: Automated RAI Measurement Framework using synthetic conversations with another LLM to evaluate jailbreaking success, potentially harmful content generation, and intellectual property leakage across multiple sub-categories
extraction_data.benchmark_result: AIME 25: 82.5; HMMT Feb 25: 81.9; OmniMath: 85.0; GPQA: 63.1; LiveCodeBench 8/24-1/25: 78.0; AIME 2024, GPQA diamond (used as progress indicators); improves significantly over Phi-4 on general-purpose benchmarks
